Bars 11-35 form a two-sided range with repeated highs at 1725.85 (bar 18) and 1845.09 (bar 19) and repeated lows at 1512.91 (bar 30) and 1551.60 (bar 34); bull and bear reversal bars alternate.

Bars 50-83 form a long, tight range: high 1974.46 (bar 61), low 1803.74 (bar 51); bars 73-83 overlap inside 1863.68-1937.76.

structures.description: Sell climax ending the window's down leg: bars 6-10 post five consecutive lower closes from 2006.17 to the window low 1368.42; bar 10 closes 1568.55 with a 200.13-point lower tail.
Post-sell-off two-sided range (bars 11-35): repeated tests of the 1512.91-1551.60 low area and the 1725.85-1845.09 high area, with most closes between 1550 and 1730.
Long, tight range (bars 50-83): high 1974.46 (bar 61), low 1803.74 (bar 51), compressing into 1863.68-1937.76 for bars 73-83 immediately before the bar 84 breakout.
Bull breakout and spike (bars 84-86): bar 84 runs 1916.51 to 2252.16 and closes near its high, above the 1974.46 range top; follow-through carries to the spike high 2771 at bar 86.
Broad post-spike range (bars 87-113): low 2357.18 (bar 98), high 2680 (bar 107); spike attempts at 2557.46, 2680 and 2609.02 all closed back inside.

Current bull leg (bars 114-117): two strong bull trend bars plus an overlapping pair break above the 2680 range top and the 2771 swing high to a new window high 2850; bars 118-120 pull back to 2633.31, still above 2680.

evidence_for: The 120-bar window shows an unbroken sequence of higher swing lows (1368.42, 1512.91, 1597.72, 1803.74, 2357.18, 2633.31) and higher swing highs (1944.39, 2771, 2850), which is the core of the bull-trend classification.
Bar 84 is a large bull trend bar closing at the top of its range with follow-through to 2771 (bars 85-86), showing acceptance above the 1803.74-1974.46 range rather than a one-bar overshoot.
The compressed final range (bars 73-83 inside 1863.68-1937.76) is a tight-range/bull-flag structure that resolved upward, consistent with trend continuation rather than a top.
The latest leg (bars 114, 117) closes above both the 2680 range top and the 2771 prior swing high, so the current structure is a breakout to a new high, not a rotation inside the 2357.18-2680 range.
Bar 120 holds above the 2680 range top and closes above its open (2686.59 versus 2684.16), so no bear breakout or acceptance back inside the range has occurred.
The bearish bars after the high are small relative to the preceding bull bars (bar 119 range 145.44 versus bar 117 range 208.31), and no bear trend bar has follow-through.
evidence_against: Strongest counterargument: the 2850 high is a single-bar spike (bar 117) with a 74.39-point upper tail, and bars 118-120 give no follow-through above it; a failed breakout would rotate price back into the 2357.18-2680 range.

Upside spike attempts inside this window have repeatedly failed: 2557.46 (bar 92), 2680 (bar 107) and 2609.02 (bar 110) were each closed back inside the range, so an overshoot above a range top is a recurring pattern here.
Bar 119 closes at 2684.16, back below the 2771 prior swing high, so the break above that swing high is not yet accepted.
Near-term momentum has turned down: bars 118 and 119 are the first two consecutive lower closes since bar 113, and bar 119 closes in the lower quarter of its range.

Bars 87-113 (27 of the last 34 bars before the breakout) traded two-sided inside 2357.18-2680, so an alternative read is a broad trading range with only a marginal upside overshoot, i.e., phase more channel/range than a fresh spike.

Bars 115 and 116 barely advance (closes 2632.98 and 2642.90) between the two strong bars, and the leg from bar 106 to 2850 contains overlapping pullbacks, which is channel rather than pure spike behavior.
transition_conditions: A close above 2850, or a bar closing in the upper third of its range above 2775.61, would confirm the breakout-spike read and favor trend continuation.
Two consecutive closes below 2633.31 (bar 120 low) would indicate a failed breakout and rotation back into the 2357.18-2680 range, moving phase toward range.
A strong bear trend bar closing below 2357.18 (bar 98 low) would end the sequence of higher swing lows and shift the regime read to trading-range or transition-unclear.

Continued overlapping bars and closes inside 2633.31-2786.81 without reaching 2850 again would raise the odds that the last leg is a channel within a broad top, changing phase to channel and lowering always-in relevance.

A pullback that holds above the 2436.87-2514.13 breakout area and then produces a close above 2786.81 would keep the bull-trend read while confirming the pullback as a buy-the-close-style continuation leg of the channel.
